question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**sustainable**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the given passage is the international forum of G20.
 
• **Now, in blank 3 will contain an adjective that will describe the noun "development."**
 
• Among the given options, the most appropriate noun to fill blank 3 is **"sustainable."**
 
• **This is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3 because it fits with the idea of maintaining something over time without causing harm or depletion.**
 
• "Sustainable" means able to be maintained at a certain level or rate without depleting natural resources or causing harm to the environment.(टिकाऊ)
 
• Grammatically, "sustainable" is an adjective that modifies the noun it is describing.
 
 
• Example: Part of their work is to pinpoint whether projects are feasible and can be sustainable
 
 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "overall", refers to the entirety of something and does not fit the context of maintaining something over time.(कुल मिलाकर)
 
• Option 3, "limited", refers to a restriction or constraint and does not fit the context of maintaining something over time without harm or depletion.(सीमित)
 
• Option 4, "continuous", refers to something that is ongoing and uninterrupted, but does not necessarily imply sustainability or lack of harm/depletion.(निरंतर)
